row.evidence: Deel documents a SCIM 2.0 API ('The SCIM API is available exclusively to Deel clients and partners with appropriate authorization') but neither the pricing page nor the docs say which plan includes it.
row.notes: Status changed gated -> unknown: June's 'Enterprise only' SCIM gate has no first-party source (Deel's pricing page lists no Enterprise tier and no SCIM or SSO line), so it was dropped. Deel documents a SCIM 2.0 Users API at https://api.letsdeel.com/scim/v2 (Organization token, Users:read/Users:write; create, PUT/PATCH, delete; no Groups), mainly used to sync Deel HR data out to Okta, JumpCloud and others. Inbound provisioning into Deel (PWAC profiles for Deel IT/Engage/HRIS) comes from Deel-run syncs: Okta API Service (daily pull) and Merge.dev for Entra ID, Google Workspace and JumpCloud. Team plan changed from June's Contractor $49/contractor/mo to Deel HR Core $5/employee/mo, the HR admin product the SCIM integrations belong to; Deel bills month-to-month.

plans.name: Deel HR Core
plans.notes: Advanced and Elite levels sit above Core; their prices appear only in a JS pricing tab and are not recorded here.

auth.token_source: Deel dashboard > More > Developer > Access Tokens > Organization token (or Apps > Okta > Generate the SCIM API Base URL and Organization token)

custom.how: Deel extension (urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:2.0:User): startDate, endDate, hiringStatus, employments, customFields, organizationalStructures, isManager; profile-level custom fields can be mapped in Okta.

rate_limits.text: Organization-wide API limit of 5 requests per second (429 on excess); SCIM docs advise retry with backoff on 429.

limitations.text: Only the SCIM User resource is supported (no Groups).
Filtering supports only eq on email.
Main documented use is Deel as the source, syncing users out to identity providers (Okta, Azure AD, OneLogin).

auth.notes: Organization, personal and worker API tokens, used as Bearer tokens; OAuth2 for partner apps.

endpoints.purpose: Create a person without a contract (PWAC)

rate_limits.text: 5 API requests per second per organization across all tokens; 429 Too Many Requests on excess.

okta.notes: OIN page marks OIDC, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate (from --checked classes in page markup). Deel's own docs describe this Okta SCIM app as syncing Deel HR data into Okta; inbound user creation in Deel from Okta is Deel's separate Okta API Service sync (row idp.okta = directory_sync).

entra.notes: Deel's Microsoft integration provisions accounts out to Entra; inbound into Deel is via Merge.dev, set up by Deel. No Entra gallery page checked.

google.notes: Inbound user provisioning from Google Workspace via Merge.dev.

jumpcloud.notes: Deel pushes workers to JumpCloud over SCIM (Deel as source); inbound via Merge.dev.

fallbacks.other_sync: Third-party user provisioning (PWAC profiles) from HRIS and IdPs: native BambooHR, HiBob, Personio, SAP SuccessFactors, Okta API Service; Merge.dev for Entra ID, Google Workspace, JumpCloud and others.

conflicts.text: Okta's OIN page marks the Deel app with SCIM Create/Update/Deactivate, but Deel's help centre describes the Okta SCIM integration as syncing employee data from Deel into Okta, and says SSO integrations such as Okta or Entra ID do not create or update worker profiles in Deel.

searched: help-centre API search: SCIM, SAML SSO
open_questions: No Deel page states which plan includes the SCIM API or SSO; the Enterprise gate recorded in June has no first-party source.
SCIM deactivation (active=false) behaviour and whether delete frees a seat are not documented.
Create, PUT, PATCH and DELETE SCIM calls appear only as examples on the overview page; the API reference lists only the two GET /scim/v2/Users endpoints.
No audit-log API was found in the developer sitemap.
Whether SAML/OIDC sign-in creates users just-in-time is not documented.
Entra gallery, Google Workspace Marketplace, OneLogin and JumpCloud catalogue pages were not checked.
Deel HR Advanced and Elite prices are shown only in a JavaScript pricing tab.
